Updates TRCA and TRCSP to use gmean and pass metrics by keyword.
Adds regression coverage for TRCSP metric variants and TRCA covariance handling.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.2修复与pyRiemann兼容，提升EEG基准评测稳定性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.2 fixes pyRiemann compatibility for EEG benchmark evaluation.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.2 fixes compatibility with pyRiemann mean APIs. - Use `gmean` in TRCA and TRCSP, supporting pyRiemann 0.12 and current 0.13 development versions. - Pass the TRCSP metric by keyword to fix fitting with pyRiemann 0.12. - Add regression coverage for three TRCSP metrics and two TRCA covariance means. This patch release is based on v1.7.1 and includes the fix from [#1180](https://github.com/N

bullets_zh: MOABB v1.7.1在NEMAR不可达时保持本地缓存的上游数据集数据可用。
在所有NEMAR下载边界捕获泄漏的httpx.TransportError异常。
保留默认auto提供程序回退到数据集自身下载器。
bullets_en: MOABB v1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable.
Catches leaked httpx.TransportError exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries.
Preserves the default auto provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader.
items.brief: MOABB 1.7.1增强NEMAR下载容错，保障本地缓存数据可用。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.1 improves NEMAR download resilience for cached benchmark datasets.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.1 keeps locally cached upstream dataset data usable when NEMAR is unreachable through a proxy or another HTTP transport failure. - Catch leaked `httpx.TransportError` exceptions at all NEMAR download boundaries. - Preserve the default `auto` provider fallback to the dataset's own downloader. See [PR #1171](https://github.com/NeuroTechX/moabb/pull/1171).

bullets_zh: MOABB 1.7.0修复离线缓存数据访问，并使数据集气泡图可复现。
`BaseDataset.get_data`在NEMAR预取前使用完整处理缓存，使无网络时仍可使用数据集。
`dataset_bubble_plot`布局变得可复现，便于基准比较。
bullets_en: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible.
`BaseDataset.get_data` uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, keeping datasets usable without network.
`dataset_bubble_plot` layout is made reproducible for benchmark comparisons.
items.brief: MOABB v1.7.0发布，提升离线可用性与气泡图可复现性。
items.brief_en: MOABB v1.7.0 improves offline cached-data access and reproducible dataset bubble plots.
items.raw_excerpt: MOABB 1.7.0 fixes offline cached-data access and makes dataset bubble plots reproducible. - `BaseDataset.get_data` now uses a complete processing cache before NEMAR prefetch, so cached datasets remain usable when NEMAR or the network is unavailable. - `dataset_bubble_plot` now has reproducible layouts by default and accepts `random_state` for controlled alternatives. Full changelog: https://moabb.

items.title_zh: MOABB：使数据集气泡图可复现（#1168）
items.title_en: [NeuroTechX/moabb] ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168)
bullets_zh: MOABB提交#1168通过用显式random_state替换全局NumPy随机状态，使数据集气泡图可复现。
固定默认值确保重复调用生成相同图形，整数种子允许受控变化。
这提高了非侵入式EEG/BCI数据集比较中基准可视化的可靠性。
bullets_en: MOABB commit #1168 makes dataset bubble plots reproducible by replacing global NumPy random state with explicit random_state.
A fixed default ensures repeated calls produce identical figures, while integer seeds allow controlled variation.
This improves reliability of benchmark visualizations for non-invasive EEG/BCI dataset comparisons.
items.brief: MOABB更新使数据集气泡图可复现，提升EEG/BCI基准可视化可靠性。
items.brief_en: MOABB update makes dataset bubble plots reproducible, improving EEG/BCI benchmark visualization reliability.
items.raw_excerpt: ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible (#1168) ENH Make dataset bubble plots reproducible Replace the global NumPy random state used by the hexagonal subject layout with an explicit random_state parameter.
